scope: Remote display photo on one Allmiibo LCD

ownerReport.displayPhoto: The owner confirmed that the display photo in the remote control works on their LCD Allmiibo.

limits: The visual result comes from the owner. The diagnostic export records the installed version and counter and contains no remote display image.
The source ID and application BIN hash in the export come from the package reference. The device reports neither value.
This test covers the display photo. A physical Android DFU interruption and recovery were outside its scope.
